query: 首席独立董事 首席独立董事 衡量企业是否设立首席独立董事（或资深独立董事）职位的制度化程度及其实际发挥的监督作用。重点考察其授权范围、召集权、对董事长的制衡能力及履职透明度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：设有首席独立董事；具备明确的职权清单（如：在董事长缺席或回避时主持会议、批准董事会会议日程）；拥有独立召集权（可定期在无内部董事参与的情况下召集独董会议）；并详细披露了年度履职报告或具体贡献。 • 1分（合格/中低分）：名义上设立了首席独立董事或类似职位，但在公司章程或治理报告中缺乏具体的职权边界说明，且未见其独立行使召集权或监督权的实质记录。 • 0分（不合格）：未设立首席独立董事，或在董事长与 CEO 合一的情况下未建立任何抵消性的独立治理机制。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：首席独立董事的职权已正式写入《公司章程》或《董事会议事规则》，且覆盖集团所有核心治理决策环节。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：仅在个别委员会（如审计委）中发挥牵头作用，或仅作为临时性安排，未形成制度化的长效机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关制度覆盖。 首席独立董事 资深独立董事 首席独立非执行董事 独董召集人 召集独董会议 纯独董会议 批准董事会议程 制衡董事长 股东沟通联系人 履职报告 SID LID Lead Independent Director Senior Independent Director Lead Independent Non-Executive Director LID SID convene independent directors independent directors-only meeting executive session board agenda approval checks on the chair shareholder liaison 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？

Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有普通独立董事名单；仅有董事会独立性比例；董事长与CEO分离但无首席独董；仅有ESG委员会主席；区分：首席独立董事关注独董领导与对董事长制衡；ESG监督委员会关注可持续发展议题监督，二者职位与职能不同。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

ESGGOVERNANCE / OUR SUSTAINABILITY MISSION

[Content]
Through adopting a top-down approach, the Board of Directors (the "Board") are responsible for developing the Group's sustainable business strategy as well as spearheading our Green Strategy to contribute our nation's carbon neutrality goal. In compliance with the Listing Rules, targets are established by the Board at the beginning of every financial year for each ma o i s o l l i i the effectiveness of the Group's ESG policies as well as overseeing a team of ESG professionals (the "Team"). The Team periodically reports to the Board to assist in identifying the ESG-related risk, assessing the internal control system, and the development of the ESG strategy. On a day-to-day basis, the Team is responsible for identifying material ESG topics and monitoring the Group's performance against ESG initiatives and key metrics across each business line.

results.text: The safety of our customers remain our utmost priority. If the Group identifies that the maintenance materials and products may have safety hazards or quality problems, the Group will trace back all affected products as soon as possible in accordance with regulations. The Group will further conduct an investigation to gain a better understanding of the situation to determine whether a recall is necessary. Once the recall is confirmed, the customer service department will be responsible for initiating the recall procedure, supervising the entire recall process, and providing compensation to the affected customers with value-added services and feedback on the extent of the impact. During the Reporting Period, there were no recall of sold or shipped products due to safety and health reasons.
